messages: anna: Quick notice 1: we're deprecating the docs-embedded example runner (the small iframe that executes snippets) in favor of the Interactive Playground. Rationale and migration plan in the playbook link below. Please review. matt: Are we removing all in-page execution or just the public hosted runner? riju: Only the hosted iframe runner is deprecated. We'll keep the static examples and the new Playground embed (which requires explicit consent for server exec). anna: Timeline: 30-day notice, 90-day grace with telemetry warnings, 180-day removal for hosted iframe. Playground embed is the recommended replacement. docs-bot: Draft published: https://internal.redwood.dev/docs/embedded-runner-deprecation (build 4890 -> staging) :white_check_mark: sam-eng: Migration notes for SDK teams: replace `
